name: middle-ground-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Middle Ground: push notifications, the account-deletion cascade, and operator alerts

engines._comment: Node 20 was deprecated 2026-04-30 and is decommissioned 2026-10-30, after which these cannot be redeployed. This is pinned in three places — here, firebase.json, and the CI workflow — and they must move together or a deploy silently keeps the old runtime.

scripts._comment_test: Explicit glob rather than `node --test test/`: Node 26 resolves a bare directory as a module path and dies with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The glob works on 20 and 26 alike.
scripts.test:rules: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "cd CloudFunctions && npm test"
